conclusion: The gate passes on the merged kernel. The slow mode of the contended lease appears on both commits, more often on 8ec2d8c in this session: 14 of 40 kernel windows at 8 and 32 callers on e3a72af, 27 of 40 on 8ec2d8c. The highest owner Enter+Leave window p99 of any candidate is 1,762 ns on e3a72af and 1,795 ns on 8ec2d8c; the failing window on fb0a86b, 5,548 ns, is 3.1 times the highest of these four runs. The 2026-11-22 failure therefore points to the host's slow mode plus one disturbed window, not to a change of the kernel. The cause of that window stays inferred: the failed run's 120 host-noise samples (../callpath-full-merge-commit/report.json) show no swap pages moved and no throttled periods, and its raw records stay on the measurement host.
